grammar: typescript
asserts: values, tql_tree, source_tree, bytecode

--- tql ---
[(. // function_declaration | text) <|> (. // class_declaration | text)]

--- source ---
function foo() {}
class Bar {}

--- values ---
[
  [
    "function foo() {}",
    "class Bar {}"
  ]
]

--- tql tree ---
(source_file (collect (union (paren (pipe (descendant . (node function_declaration)) (call text))) (paren (pipe (descendant . (node class_declaration)) (call text))))))

--- source tree ---
(program (function_declaration name: (identifier) parameters: (formal_parameters) body: (statement_block)) (class_declaration name: (type_identifier) body: (class_body)))
